papers.title: TokenFlow: Consistent Diffusion Features for Consistent Video Editing
papers.topic: Text-guided editing of an input video, with inter-frame feature propagation for temporal consistency.

papers.title: DiffPerformer: Iterative Learning of Consistent Latent Guidance for Diffusion-Based Human Video Generation
papers.topic: Pose-guided human video generation with temporally consistent latent guidance.

papers.title: Ctrl-Adapter: An Efficient and Versatile Framework for Adapting Diverse Controls to Any Diffusion Model
papers.topic: Adapts controls to image and video diffusion models; applications include video generation, editing and motion control.

papers.title: COVE: Unleashing the Diffusion Feature Correspondence for Consistent Video Editing
papers.topic: Uses diffusion feature correspondences for temporally consistent editing of source videos.

papers.title: FLATTEN: optical FLow-guided ATTENtion for consistent text-to-video editing
papers.topic: Optical-flow-guided attention for text-guided video editing and consistency.

papers.title: Ground-A-Video: Zero-shot Grounded Video Editing using Text-to-image Diffusion Models
papers.topic: Grounding-guided multi-attribute editing of input videos.

papers.title: Video-P2P: Video Editing with Cross-Attention Control
papers.topic: Text-driven editing of real videos using cross-attention control.

papers.title: DIVE: Taming DINO for Subject-Driven Video Editing
papers.topic: Subject-driven editing of source videos conditioned on text or reference images.

papers.title: Pathways on the Image Manifold: Image Editing via Video Generation
papers.topic: Uses video generation as an intermediate method to produce an edited image; the stated end task and evaluation are image editing.

papers.title: EditVerse: Unifying Image and Video Editing and Generation with In-Context Learning
papers.topic: Unified image and video generation and editing, including instruction-based video editing.

papers.title: EasyCreator: Empowering 4D Creation through Video Inpainting
papers.topic: Generates and edits 4D video content from monocular video using a video-inpainting model.

papers.title: MiVE: Multiscale Vision-language features for reference-guided video Editing
papers.topic: Reference-image and text-guided editing of an input video.

papers.title: MoCa: Modeling Object Consistency for 3D Camera Control in Video Generation
papers.topic: Camera-controllable video generation with object consistency across frames.

papers.title: A Video is Worth 256 Bases: Spatial-Temporal Expectation-Maximization Inversion for Zero-Shot Video Editing
papers.topic: Spatial-temporal inversion for zero-shot video editing and temporal consistency.
